name: Mahanadi

sink.name: Mahanadi Delta, near Paradeep (False Point)
sink.location: Jagatsinghpur district, Odisha, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: The Mahanadi is the third-largest peninsular river in India by basin area, after the Godavari and Krishna.
The Hirakud Dam, built across the Mahanadi in 1957, was the first major multipurpose river valley project of independent India and impounds one of Asia's largest artificial lakes.
The river cuts a 64 km gorge through the Eastern Ghats at Satkosia before splitting into distributaries at Cuttack to form its delta.
